embedding.projection_policy: One PCA fitted to baseline training vectors, then frozen for test before/after projections. Two displayed dimensions omit information; full 128-D similarities drive evaluation.

protocol.mnr_batch: one positive pair per distinct intent; no duplicate text or latent positive as an in-batch negative
protocol.splits: No exact sentence or pair ID shared between train, validation, test or unlabeled silver pool; intent categories recur by design.
protocol.selection: Models selected using validation only. Test is evaluated after selection; no test-driven hyperparameter changes.
protocol.silver: Teacher trained on gold train only, selected on gold validation. Candidate silver pairs use separate training-only pool; no evaluation sentences. Latent intent is available only for explicit diagnostic review, never teacher target labels.

protocol.mnr_batch: one positive pair per distinct intent; no duplicate text or latent positive as an in-batch negative
protocol.splits: No exact sentence or pair ID shared between train, validation, test or unlabeled silver pool; intent categories recur by design.
protocol.selection: Models selected using validation only. Test is evaluated after selection; no test-driven hyperparameter changes.
protocol.silver: Teacher trained on gold train only, selected on gold validation. Candidate silver pairs use separate training-only pool; no evaluation sentences. Latent intent is available only for explicit diagnostic review, never teacher target labels.

augmentation.comparison_limit: Equal 60-step student budgets and initialization; adding silver changes pair distribution and exposure, not only label quality. Teacher errors remain visible; no independent benchmark claim.
